operations.content:
from pathlib import Path
import json,time
p=Path.home()/'.codex/models_cache.json'
if p.is_symlink() or not p.is_file():
    raise RuntimeError('MODEL_CACHE_UNAVAILABLE')
v=json.loads(p.read_text())
models=v.get('models',[])
visible=[m for m in models if isinstance(m,dict) and m.get('visibility')=='list']
pairs=[{'name':m.get('display_name'),'slug':m.get('slug'),'visibility':m.get('visibility')} for m in models if isinstance(m,dict)]
required={'gpt-5.6 sol','gpt-6 astra'}
found={str(m.get('display_name') or '').strip().casefold() for m in visible}
summary={'age_h':round((time.time()-p.stat().st_mtime)/3600,1),'names':[str(m.get('display_name') or m.get('slug'))[:35] for m in visible][:5],'slugs':[str(m.get('slug'))[:32] for m in visible][:5]}
out=Path.cwd()/'diagnostic-result'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(out/'model-identity.json').write_text(json.dumps({'models':pairs,'summary':summary,'exact_required_available':required<=found,'full_chain_pass':False},indent=2))
print('MODEL_IDENTITY '+json.dumps(summary,separators=(',',':')),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(0 if required<=found else 1)
